answer: Audits are logged in quill, queued in marble, and ledge publishes the wait time. A farm of 21 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 43 identities per epoch. A farm of 3480 identities would post 1560 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
